description: This Java class `GenericSecret` extends `CommonSecret` and encapsulates additional properties for secret management in a credentials context. It utilizes Jackson annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization to handle dynamic properties.

classes.name: GenericSecret
classes.description: A class representing generic secret credentials with dynamic properties, extending CommonSecret.

methods.name: setAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Setter for the additionalProperties map, allows setting multiple custom properties at once.

methods.name: getAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Getter for retrieving the map of additional properties, used during JSON serialization.
